description.value: Torake is a contemporary Japanese restaurant in Richmond that blends modern Japanese and French culinary techniques, emphasizing locally-sourced and seasonal ingredients. Guests can sit at the sushi bar to watch chefs work up close, or settle into the intimate dining room for a multi-sensory tasting experience. The restaurant also operates a catering arm, suggesting some flexibility beyond in-house dining.
